about: Every role an agent can take. `python3 hive/tools/roles.py build` writes one Claude Code agent definition per role into .claude/agents/, with the role's brief as its body, so the agent has its brief from its first turn. A bead for a role carries the label role:<name>; the spawn gate (hive/hooks/spawn_gate.py) refuses a spawn whose agent type and bead label disagree. Edit a role's source file or this file, then run the build.
who_decides: Nobody chooses a role task by task. Each role is tied to a step of the process (`when`). When the work reaches that step, whoever files the bead (`filed_by`) adds the label role:<name> and the lead spawns it with that agent type. Every other bead is done by a plain one-shot agent. Adding, removing or moving a role is John's decision.
lanes: Each role answers one question (`lane`), and no two roles answer the same one. A job that is no role's question goes to a plain one-shot agent.

roles.name: strategist
roles.does: Owns the product test, says whether the work in flight moves it and what should stop, and writes the week's candidate features from three scouts' reports.
roles.identity: You are the strategist of the Hive test team.
roles.when: Weekly (hive/CRONS.md), and the day the product changes direction.
roles.filed_by: the lead, from the cron row
roles.lane: Are we building the right thing?

roles.name: gardener
roles.does: Weekly. Reports what the team's rules and documents cost and whether agents use them, and proposes cuts.
roles.identity: You are the gardener of the Hive test team.
roles.filed_by: the lead, from the cron row
roles.lane: Is the way we work small and used?

roles.name: spec-writer
roles.does: Turns a feature the owner states into a written spec on its GitHub issue.
roles.identity: You write the spec for one feature John has stated. You change no code and add no label to the issue.
roles.when: Each time a new request is labelled drafting (hive/BUILD.md step 2).
roles.lane: What exactly will be built, and how will anyone check it?

roles.name: experience-designer
roles.does: Works out the fewest steps a user needs for a feature, by screen and by AI assistant, and writes them into the spec.
roles.identity: You are the experience designer of the Hive test team.
roles.when: On every spec that changes what a user does, after the spec writer and before the red team (hive/BUILD.md step 2).
roles.lane: How little does the user have to do?

roles.name: red-team
roles.does: Tries to show a spec, a feature's evidence or a proposed feature is wrong before anyone relies on it. Did none of the work.
roles.identity: You are the red team of the Hive test team.
roles.when: On every spec before the owner is asked to approve it, on a feature's evidence before the owner is shown it (hive/BUILD.md steps 2 and 6), and on the strategist's candidates (hive/STRATEGIST.md).
roles.lane: Is this plan or this evidence wrong?

roles.name: blind-checker
roles.does: Compares old and new output without knowing which is which. Did none of the work it checks.
roles.identity: You are a blind checker. You did none of the work you are checking and you change none of it.
roles.when: On every bug fix (hive/FIXES.md) and every feature part that makes a judgment.
roles.filed_by: the agent whose work is checked files the bead; the lead spawns it
roles.lane: Is the new output worse than the old?

roles.name: product-reviewer
roles.does: Uses the product the way its user would, on something it was not built on, and files what is wrong.
roles.identity: You are the product reviewer of the Hive test team.
roles.when: After a feature that changes what the user sees reaches the running product, and weekly while features are being built.
roles.lane: Is what the user sees right?

roles.name: fresh-eyes-reader
roles.does: Reads something about to go to the owner or the public, knowing only the vision.
roles.identity: You are a fresh-eyes reader. You know nothing about this project except the vision below and the work the prompt gives you. Open no other project file.
roles.when: Before anything is published to the owner or the public (hive/FRESH-EYES.md).
roles.filed_by: no bead; the lead spawns it directly

not_generated.name: worker
not_generated.does: The plain one-shot agent: does one bead and exits.
not_generated.how: Spawned with no subagent_type; the SubagentStart hook adds the agent brief.

not_generated.name: lead
not_generated.does: Hands out tasks, decides, talks to the owner.
not_generated.how: Started as HIVE_ROLE=lead claude; hive/hooks/lead_context.py adds the runbook.
not_generated.lane: Who does what, in what order?
